description.value: Island View Lodge is a modern 30-room motel in Powell River, BC, offering air-conditioned rooms with private balconies and complimentary Wi-Fi. The property sits steps from Townsite Brewing and is a short drive from Willingdon Beach Park and Second Beach, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast. It is pet-friendly in designated rooms and accepts major credit and debit cards.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and detailed, confirming an open 30-room motel in Powell River, BC with complimentary wireless internet (corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag) and free onsite parking. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; those are all null. The website explicitly places the property steps from Townsite Brewing, providing positive evidence for nearby evening food.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but the website clearly places the property in Powell River, BC (Sunshine Coast region, not Vancouver Island proper).
Full civic address (city, province, postal code) is absent from OSM tags; only street number and street name are recorded.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with an active website and confirmed contact details; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists in Powell River.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states property is 'steps from Townsite Brewing'
